_note: Business-model rewrite of design/marketing/For Experts.dc.html at /for-experts — the same change as architect-landing.json, applied to the expert recruiting page. The design replaced the escrow payout-math card (client funds escrow → 10% platform fee → you keep) with the three-tier subscription section; the tiers live in payments.SubscriptionPlan (group 'standard'), and `plans_label` / `plans_footnote` here are the card header and billing line around them. `earnings_example_label` and `earnings_release_label` belonged to the retired card and are blanked. `delete` removes the escrow/payout personas and every stat, step, value prop and FAQ whose natural key the design renamed, because seeds/content_copy.json and seeds/content_blocks.json were extracted from the superseded revision and re-seed them on every run. Vocabulary throughout: orders → introductions/intros. `tools_link` and `pricing_link` are the entry points to the two dedicated expert pages (design/marketing/Professional Tools.dc.html and Expert Pricing.dc.html): the design ships them as orphans, so this page's tools grid and plan column each link out to the deep dive, the same way the landing page's categories_sub pairs with categories_link.

testimonials.name: Sam T.
testimonials.quote: Steady drafting work without the sales grind. Clients hire me directly and pay my rate — no cut taken, no chasing a platform for my money.

faqs.question: What does it cost to join?
faqs.answer: Applying is free. Once you’re approved and live, you pay a flat monthly subscription — plans start at $79/mo — and nothing else. We never take a cut of your project fees.

faqs.question: How are orders matched to me?
faqs.answer: The engine matches on your discipline and specialties, your capacity, your rates, and — for stamped work — your verified license and jurisdiction. You see the scoped introduction and accept or decline; nothing is ever assigned.

faqs.question: How do I get paid?
faqs.answer: You contract and invoice the client directly, at your own rate. Payment happens between you and the owner — we’re not in the transaction and take nothing from it.
